flaws.note: RLS is enabled on messages, but the select policy is using (true): any signed-in user can read every message of every workspace through PostgREST, whatever the room policy hides in the UI.
next.config env inlines SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY into the client bundle, and RoomPresence, a client component, imports the admin client, so the key ships to every browser.
Sign-up creates confirmed users and workspaces with the admin client, with no rate limit or captcha; AUDIT.md's claim that the platform handles it is false for this route.
